author: Henry James
title: The Turn of the Screw, in The Two Magics
edition: New York: The Macmillan Company; London: Macmillan & Co., Ltd., 1898. Scan-backed Wikisource transcription of this edition; chapter headings, navigation and page-number anchors omitted from prose excerpts; HTML line-wrapping whitespace collapsed. The library text holds the whole volume's fiction: The Turn of the Screw (the untitled prologue and Chapters I to XXIV) and Covering End (Chapters I to VIII), each under its printed title and chapter numerals; the title page, contents and publisher's advertisements are omitted. The Wikisource Covering End Chapter 7 page also transcludes the opening of Chapter VIII from the shared scan page; that repeated passage is kept once, under Chapter VIII.

rights.basis: This 1898 English-language edition was published before 1931 and is in the US public domain as of 2026; only James’s narrative is supplied, with no modern annotation.
